summary: Focused re-test of the iteration 5 fixes. All 5 fixes pass. (1) Mobile overflow: rebuilt the scratch reproduction (/tmp/mm/grid2.html) with the app's production CSS and the exact classes 'grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 lg:grid-cols-2 [&>*]:min-w-0'. It has a 1872px SVG, a long LR mermaid <pre> and an unbreakable table cell. At 390px, scrollWidth is 390 (column 358px). At 1920px it shows 2 columns of 604px. The [&>*]:min-w-0 rule is in the built CSS. The class is in generate, share and student/notifications. (2) --destructive is 0 72% 45% in :root and .dark, and .dashboard-shell doesn't override it. text-destructive is rgb(197,32,32) and the success colour is rgb(31,132,78), so they are clearly different. admin/metrics shows failing NEP scores (<70) with text-destructive. (3) Favicon: /icon.svg returns 200 and <link rel=icon href=/icon.svg?...> is in the head of /, /login and /signup. (4) Nav: Button asChild(Slot)+Link, so no button is nested inside an anchor. The testids nav-link-* and nav-mobile-link-* are unique per role (all hrefs are distinct). tsc exits 0. (5) PPTX: rebuilt deck-diagrams.pptx, converted it to PDF (10 pages) and made a contact sheet. diagram1.png is 1872x226 (ratio 8.3). Slide 6 now puts the LR Calvin-cycle flowchart full width under the bullets, and it is readable. Captions are 10pt #4B5563. Public pages at desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844 (/, /login, /signup): no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth equals the viewport), body background rgb(245,250,247), no console errors or warnings. Protected routes /professor, /student, /admin and /professor/generate return 307 to /login?next=. Regression: npm test 38/38, tsc 0, lint 0 errors (4 warnings), pytest test_unauth_api.py 33/33.

issues: The Commons 'photosynthesis chemical equation' image is 960x720 (ratio 1.33), so it stays in the side panel. The equation in it is a thin strip with a lot of whitespace, so it looks tiny and is hard to read. The aspect-ratio rule can't catch this. Consider trimming whitespace or choosing a different image. Low priority.

critical_code_review_comments: app-nav.tsx: the asChild pattern is correct. The testid is derived from the href, so it would collide if 2 items ever share an href. That's fine today.

exporters.ts addDeckSlide: the wide layout fits the bullets into h=3.4 with fit:'shrink'. LibreOffice ignores shrink, so 6 or more long bullets could overflow into the image at y=4.75. That's fine for the current deck.
